rules.title: Los Angeles RSO annual allowable rent increase
rules.requirement: If your unit is covered by the Los Angeles Rent Stabilization Ordinance, your landlord could raise rent by no more than 3% for July 1, 2025 – June 30, 2026. Starting February 2, 2026, landlords may not add any extra percentage for utilities. Check whether your unit is covered at zimas.lacity.org or by texting RSO to 1(855) 880-7368.

coverage.summary: Rental units subject to the City of Los Angeles Rent Stabilization Ordinance (RSO); the page does not state which buildings are covered.

rules.quoted_span:
Annual rent increases for rental units subject to the City of Los Angeles Rent Stabilization Ordinance (RSO), effective
July 1, 2025, through June 30, 2026
is
3%
.
rules.interaction: Landlords may also pass through the RSO surcharge ($1.61/month) and the SCEP surcharge ($2.83/month) with written notice, after registering units. State law requires 30 days' written notice for increases under 10%.
rules.conflict_note: The page was retrieved 2026-10-01 but still lists only the July 1, 2025 – June 30, 2026 figure. The allowable increase for July 1, 2026 onward is not stated. The page also gives no municipal code citation and no coverage cutoffs.

notes: The document is an LAHD calculator page. Only the RSO annual increase figure was extracted. The side rules are summarized in the record and not extracted separately: the end of the utility percentage add-on beginning Feb 2, 2026, the SCEP and RSO surcharge pass-throughs, and the state 30-day notice requirement. The notice rule is procedural and outside the six categories. The RSO code citation (LAMC ch. XV) is not stated in the document, so the ordinance name was used.
